faq.question: Can you respond to public tenders?
faq.answer: Yes. We can prepare a response to public procurement procedures and provide the required certificates and references.

faq.question: Do you work at night and on weekends?
faq.answer: Yes. Schedules are built around your operating hours, including nights, weekends and public holidays.

faq.question: How do you report on the work done?
faq.answer: Rounds are logged on site, and we provide regular reports with inspections, incidents and any issues to be addressed.
